source_text: Recapitulatio Libri II historica: sponsa se nigram et formosam confitetur; sol tentationum decolorat; filii matris pugnant; custos vinearum fit; ubi pascas in meridie quaerit; nisi se cognoverit, haedos pascet; equitatui assimilatur; fasciculus myrrhae et botrus cypri dilectum significant; pulchritudo mutua et cubile umbrosum concludunt.
pass_a_gloss: Recapitulation of-Book II historical: bride herself black and beautiful confesses; sun of-trials discolors...
pass_b_english: Historical recapitulation of Book II: the Bride confesses herself black and beautiful; the sun of trials discolors her; her mother’s sons fight her; she is made keeper of vineyards; she asks where he pastures at noon; unless she knows herself she will pasture goats; she is likened to cavalry; the bundle of myrrh and cluster of henna signify the Beloved; mutual beauty and the shaded couch conclude.
